_meta.notes: T06 tumbling motion after an uproot: a deterministic rigid-body hop, bounce and roll. Values are data so the fall can be tuned without touching code.

impulse_min_mps.notes: Slowest launch speed an uproot can give the body.

impulse_max_mps.notes: Fastest launch speed an uproot can give the body.

ground_friction_per_s.notes: Horizontal speed bled off per second while the body touches the ground.

bounce_damping.notes: Share of vertical speed kept after each ground contact. 0 stops dead, 1 never loses height.

max_tumble_seconds.notes: Longest a body tumbles before it is treated as settled even if still drifting.

impact_damage_per_mps.notes: Damage per m/s of vertical impact above impact_damage_min_speed_mps.

impact_damage_min_speed_mps.notes: Impact speed below which landing on the ground does no further damage.

roll_speed_max_rad_per_s.notes: Fastest roll the body picks up when it is thrown.

settle_speed_mps.notes: Speed under which a grounded body counts as settled.
